run_sequential_simulation: run a turn-based simulation loop with game masters and entities using the Sequential engine
create_sequential_engine: create a Sequential engine instance with custom call prompts for observation, acting, and resolution
resolve_putative_event: resolve a putative event by observing it with the game master and generating the outcome
select_next_acting_entity: select the next entity to act and get its action spec from the game master
check_termination: check whether the simulation should terminate by asking the game master for a binary decision
